conventions.note: Paths are written out literally rather than derived so this file can be published to public/videos/gt70/manifest.json unchanged and consumed by tooling with no knowledge of the code.

policy.mountRule: A clip may only be handed to a <video> element when status is 'approved' AND both desktop and mobile sources are present. Everything else renders its poster, so the site never shows a blank rectangle and never ships a fabricated asset.
policy.technicalQc: Automated QC proves codec, constant frame rate, resolution, colour range and byte-range delivery. It cannot prove the vehicle is the correct GT70.
policy.visualQc: Vehicle identity, part count, geometry, livery and physics still require a human watch-through before a clip may be treated as final.
policy.contentFactualRule: No numerical specification, price, range figure or award may be burned into a frame. Only facts published by YADEA may appear on the page, each carrying its own sourceUrl.

clips.note: Assembled from a supplied 299-frame 2560x1440 sequence (frames 001-299, contiguous, no gaps or duplicates) at a true constant 30 fps, so playback timing is 1:1 with the source. Frames were full-range yuvj420p, so the master remaps to limited-range yuv420p; verified against the source at SSIM 0.9935. Delivery width capped at 1920 with a 960px mobile encode. Source capture FPS was not supplied and 30 fps was inferred from the 299-frame, ~10s sequence. Technical QC passed; vehicle identity still needs a human watch-through.
